item.name: Research completeness
item.description: Was the research as thorough and complete as reasonably possible?

item.name: Adopting and engaging with feedback
item.description:
- Did you adopt the feedback and make changes apparent through production reports?
- If you don’t agree with feedback, are you engaging in conversation with the instructor to discuss and clarify?

item.name: Evidence of mastery in tools and craft
item.description:
- Are you using tools, techniques, methods, and skills relevant to accomplishing your project goals?
- Are you using elements and principles of art and design effectively?
